roadmap.goalZh: 统一内核构建、依赖检查与镜像入口。
roadmap.goalEn: Make kernel builds, dependency checks and image creation reproducible.
roadmap.detailZh: Cargo 工作区隔离宿主 xtask 与裸机内核，校验引导输入。
roadmap.detailEn: The workspace separates the host xtask from the bare-metal kernel and verifies boot inputs.

roadmap.goalZh: 在 q35 / OVMF 下通过 Limine 引导。
roadmap.goalEn: Boot through Limine on q35 with OVMF.
roadmap.detailZh: 串口保留启动阶段和故障信息，smoke 检查有序标记与退出结果。
roadmap.detailEn: Serial logs identify boot phases and failures. Smoke tests check ordered markers and exit status.

roadmap.goalZh: 建立启动处理器的异常处理与定时中断。
roadmap.goalEn: Handle exceptions and timer interrupts on the bootstrap processor.
roadmap.detailZh: 验证 GDT、IDT、ACPI 与 LAPIC 定时器。外设中断仍屏蔽，I/O APIC 标识差异已有单独回归。
roadmap.detailEn: The profile covers GDT, IDT, ACPI and the LAPIC timer. Peripheral interrupts remain masked, with a regression for differing I/O APIC IDs.

roadmap.goalZh: 接管页表并保护内核堆和执行栈。
roadmap.goalEn: Own page tables and protect the kernel heap and stack.
roadmap.detailZh: 实测页回收、保护页、只读与 NX 故障，以及内存耗尽恢复。
roadmap.detailEn: Tests exercise frame reclamation, guard pages, read-only and NX faults, and allocation failure.

roadmap.goalZh: 运行独立地址空间中的 Ring 3 程序。
roadmap.goalEn: Run Ring 3 applications in private address spaces.
roadmap.detailZh: 原生 C 和 Rust ELF 使用受检系统调用，错误指针及用户故障被隔离。
roadmap.detailEn: Native C and Rust executables use checked system calls. Invalid pointers and user faults are isolated.

roadmap.goalZh: 建立单处理器上的用户抢占与阻塞等待。
roadmap.goalEn: Preempt user processes and block waiting tasks on one CPU.
roadmap.detailZh: 支持 fork、exec、wait 和上下文恢复；SMP 与内核抢占另行规划。
roadmap.detailEn: The gate covers fork, exec, wait and context restoration. SMP and kernel preemption are outside this profile.

roadmap.goalZh: 让应用通过统一文件接口与管道协作。
roadmap.goalEn: Connect applications through files and pipes.
roadmap.detailZh: 验证 initramfs、tmpfs、devfs、重定向、文件描述符及原生 shell；tmpfs 为易失存储。
roadmap.detailEn: The native shell exercises initramfs, tmpfs, devfs, descriptor handling and redirection. The tmpfs mount is volatile.

roadmap.goalZh: 在 virtio-blk 上保存文本与可执行文件。
roadmap.goalEn: Keep edited sources and executables on virtio-blk storage.
roadmap.detailZh: 受控 ext2 卷经正常关机、重启与 e2fsck 检查；此卷没有日志恢复。
roadmap.detailEn: A bounded ext2 volume passed clean shutdown, reboot and e2fsck checks. This volume has no journal recovery.

roadmap.goalZh: 为固定构建的 musl 程序提供 Linux ABI 子集。
roadmap.goalEn: Provide a Linux ABI subset for pinned musl executables.
roadmap.detailZh: 验证选定 BusyBox 命令、文件操作、管道和重定向，范围以兼容性表为准。
roadmap.detailEn: Selected BusyBox applets, file operations, pipes and redirection passed. The compatibility matrix defines the accepted subset.

roadmap.goalZh: 覆盖受控的动态加载与终端运行时。
roadmap.goalEn: Support dynamic loading and terminal primitives for selected programs.
roadmap.detailZh: 验证 pthread、TLS、futex、信号及四个 PTY；完整作业控制与 glibc 尚未验证。
roadmap.detailEn: Tests cover pthreads, TLS, futexes, signals and four PTYs. Full job control and glibc remain unverified.

roadmap.goalZh: 以受控网络验证连接与软件包生命周期。
roadmap.goalEn: Exercise network clients and package lifecycles on a controlled network.
roadmap.detailZh: 轮询 virtio-net 支持 IPv4、TCP/UDP、有限 DNS；验证 TLS、哈希、升级与回滚。
roadmap.detailEn: Polled virtio-net serves IPv4, TCP/UDP and bounded DNS. Tests cover TLS, hashes, upgrades and rollback.

roadmap.zh: 系统内 C / C++ 开发
roadmap.goalZh: 在 AnovaOS 内编辑、编译并运行程序。
roadmap.goalEn: Edit, compile and run applications inside AnovaOS.
roadmap.detailZh: 宿主准备 GCC/G++、binutils 与 make，来宾实际完成编译；已测试异常、线程与重启保留。
roadmap.detailEn: Host-prepared GCC/G++, binutils and make perform real guest builds. Exceptions, threads and reboot retention were tested.

roadmap.goalZh: 运行固定 Rust 工具并构建 musl 应用。
roadmap.goalEn: Run pinned Rust tools and build musl applications.
roadmap.detailZh: 离线依赖、build.rs、过程宏及受控 HTTPS 已验证。工具二进制来自上游，原生 AnovaOS std 仍独立规划。
roadmap.detailEn: Offline builds, build.rs, procedural macros and bounded HTTPS passed. The tools are upstream binaries. Native AnovaOS std is a separate goal.

roadmap.goalZh: 统一原生应用的创建、编译、打包与诊断。
roadmap.goalEn: Unify native app creation, building, packaging and diagnostics.
roadmap.detailZh: C、C++、Rust 模板使用版本化 SDK 和 ANOVAPK2；校验 ABI 并支持故障符号化。
roadmap.detailEn: C, C++ and Rust templates use a versioned SDK and ANOVAPK2, with ABI admission and fault symbolization.

roadmap.goalZh: 从受检帧缓冲走向用户态窗口合成。
roadmap.goalEn: Extend a checked framebuffer into a user-space compositor.
roadmap.detailZh: M14.1–14.5 已本地验收。桌面使用软件合成，VirGL 验收范围为离屏清除、回读及回退。
roadmap.detailEn: M14.1–14.5 have local acceptance. Desktop composition uses software rendering. VirGL coverage is limited to offscreen clear, readback and fallback.

roadmap.goalZh: 在来宾内从源码重建工具与内核。
roadmap.goalEn: Reconstruct selected tools and the kernel inside the guest.
roadmap.detailZh: bzip2 与内核的重复干净构建已验证，引导镜像由宿主打包。GCC、LLVM/rustc/Cargo 完成可行性评估，编译器重构仍受阻。
roadmap.detailEn: Repeated clean bzip2 and kernel builds passed with host-assisted image packaging. GCC and LLVM/rustc/Cargo feasibility was assessed. Compiler reconstruction remains blocked.

roadmap.goalZh: 扩展文件后端、日志恢复与开发容量。
roadmap.goalEn: Expand storage backends, journal recovery and build capacity.
roadmap.detailZh: ext4 读写、JBD2、全新工作盘迁移和资源耗尽后内核构建已本地验收。完整远程 CI 收尾延期。
roadmap.detailEn: Controlled ext4 reads/writes, JBD2 recovery, fresh-disk migration and kernel builds after exhaustion passed locally. Full remote CI closeout is deferred.

roadmap.goalZh: 在图形会话中编辑、编译和运行固定应用。
roadmap.goalEn: Edit, build and run fixed application recipes in a graphical session.
roadmap.detailZh: M17.1–17.5 的受监督会话、真实 PTY、文件编辑、监控与三语言工作流通过本地 QEMU 验收。物理硬件另需验证。
roadmap.detailEn: Local QEMU evidence covers the supervised session, real PTY, editor, monitor and three-language recipes across M17.1–17.5. Physical hardware needs separate validation.

roadmap.goalZh: 分别复查编译器重构和纯来宾镜像生成的前置条件。
roadmap.goalEn: Reassess prerequisites for compiler reconstruction and guest-only boot images independently.
roadmap.detailZh: GCC、LLVM/rustc/Cargo、镜像生成与可重复构建均为后续目标。镜像路线可独立评估，当前没有完成记录。
roadmap.detailEn: GCC, LLVM/rustc/Cargo, image creation and repeatability each have separate future gates. The image path can be assessed independently.

features.goalZh: no_std Rust 内核接管四级页表，管理物理页、堆与隔离地址空间。
features.goalEn: A no_std Rust kernel owns four-level page tables, physical frames, the heap and isolated address spaces.
features.detailZh: 本地测试覆盖保护页、NX、越界与内存耗尽。当前内核堆固定为 16 MiB。
features.detailEn: Local tests exercise guard pages, NX, bounds and allocation failure. The kernel currently uses a fixed 16 MiB heap.

features.goalZh: 在单个启动处理器上运行 Ring 3 进程，支持用户抢占、阻塞、fork、exec 和 wait。
features.goalEn: Ring 3 processes on one bootstrap CPU support user preemption, blocking, fork, exec and wait.
features.detailZh: 32 个槽位由进程与线程共享。内核不可抢占，尚未验证 SMP。
features.detailEn: Processes and threads share 32 slots. The kernel is non-preemptible and SMP remains unverified.

features.goalZh: VFS 连接内存文件系统、ext2 和受控 ext4。JBD2 工作卷提供日志重放。
features.goalEn: The VFS connects memory filesystems, ext2 and controlled ext4. JBD2 work volumes support journal replay.
features.detailZh: ext4 接受声明的特性集合，单文件上限 256 MiB。ext2 单文件上限 4 MiB，不带日志。
features.detailEn: Only declared ext4 features are accepted. Files are bounded to 256 MiB on controlled ext4 and 4 MiB on non-journaled ext2.

features.goalZh: 用 C、C++ 或 Rust 模板建立应用，通过原生 ABI 运行并打包。
features.goalEn: Create native applications from C, C++ or Rust templates, run them via the native ABI and package them.
features.detailZh: 包准入检查架构与 ABI，工具可符号化用户故障。应用权限清单仅是准入元数据。
features.detailEn: Package admission checks architecture and ABI. Tools symbolize user faults. Declared permissions are admission metadata.

features.goalZh: 在 AnovaOS 内用 GCC/G++ 与 Rust/Cargo 完成经过验证的编辑、构建和运行流程。
features.goalEn: Use GCC/G++ and Rust/Cargo inside AnovaOS for verified edit, build and run workflows.
features.detailZh: 依赖宿主准备的种子工具与 musl 环境；原生 Rust std、编译器源码自举仍待独立验证。
features.detailEn: These profiles require host-prepared seed tools and a musl environment. Native Rust std and compiler reconstruction have separate gates.

features.goalZh: 显式 Linux ABI 适配层支持特定 musl ELF、BusyBox 命令和动态库。
features.goalEn: An explicit Linux ABI adapter runs selected musl executables, BusyBox applets and shared libraries.
features.detailZh: 兼容性按软件、版本、构建参数与操作逐项记录。通用 glibc 应用尚未验证。
features.detailEn: Compatibility is tracked by program, version, build configuration and operation. General glibc applications remain unverified.

features.goalZh: Rust 用户态合成器管理窗口、焦点与输入。启动器提供文件、构建及服务入口。
features.goalEn: A Rust user-space compositor manages windows, focus and input. The launcher provides file, build and service controls.
features.detailZh: 本地 QEMU 的有限客户端会话已验证，普通桌面采用软件合成。
features.detailEn: Local QEMU tests cover the bounded client session. The normal desktop uses software composition.

features.goalZh: 图形终端连接真实 Linux-musl PTY，处理 shell 输入、Ctrl+C、调整大小和回滚查看。
features.goalEn: The graphical terminal connects to a real Linux-musl PTY, with shell input, Ctrl+C, resizing and scrollback.
features.detailZh: 验证包括真实 GCC 编译与重启后文件字节比对；支持有限 ANSI 序列和历史缓冲区。
features.detailEn: The gate includes a real GCC compile and exact file-byte checks after reboot. ANSI handling and scrollback are bounded.

features.goalZh: q35 / OVMF 配置下使用 virtio-blk、可选 virtio-net、PS/2 和 VGA。
features.goalEn: The q35/OVMF profile uses virtio-blk, optional virtio-net, PS/2 and VGA.
features.detailZh: 网络为轮询 IPv4 客户端及有限 DNS。外设 IRQ 仍屏蔽，USB、物理硬件及通用 GPU 驱动尚未验证。
features.detailEn: Networking covers polled IPv4 clients and bounded DNS. Peripheral IRQs remain masked. USB, physical hardware and general GPU drivers remain unverified.

updates.titleEn: Boot fix for differing I/O APIC IDs

updates.titleEn: M17 development desktop merged into dev
